pages.text: A $(item)Crucible$() works like a furnace: gold ingots on top, a refining salt in the fuel slot, $(item)Fine Gold$() out, at the salt's ★. It glows while it works.$(li)$(item)Bone Ash$(): bone meal and charcoal. ★3$(li)$(item)Assay Salt$(): borax and bone ash. ★5$(li)$(item)Sunsalt$(): assay salt and Arcane Dust. ★7
pages.title: Refining

pages.text: Each salt refines four ingots. Better salts take longer: 30 seconds an ingot with bone ash, a minute with assay salt, a minute and a half with sunsalt (a quarter less in a Great Crucible). The goldsmithy must be good enough for the salt.
